mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO service provider for my accounting firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing an AEO service provider for your accounting firm involves evaluating their experience, understanding of the accounting industry, and their track record. Look for providers who demonstrate a deep understanding of AI search technologies and how to structure content for direct answers. Request case studies or examples of their work with similar businesses. A good provider will conduct a thorough initial assessment, clearly explain their strategy, and offer transparent reporting. Prioritize those who focus on measurable results and have communication practices that align with your firm's needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select an AEO provider by checking their experience, industry understanding, case studies, and transparent reporting. They should explain strategy clearly and focus on measurable results.
